english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for winning a game, battle, prize, or contest.

exampleSentences.english: We win the match at last.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 jeng4 zo2 coeng4 bo1

english.note: Use this when framing the result from the winner's side, as in beating someone in a game or contest.

exampleSentences.english: We managed to defeat them in this match.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jeng4 zo2 keoi5 dei6

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when “prevail” means to win or triumph.

exampleSentences.english: We will prevail in this match.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 jat1 ding6 jeng4

english.note: Use this for prevailing or winning against someone in a contest, conflict, or other competition.

exampleSentences.english: We need teamwork to overcome our opponents.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋要靠團隊合作先贏到對手。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kaau3 tyun4 deoi6 hap6 zok3 sin1 jeng4 dou2 deoi3 sau2
